citations.claim: At first violating step the body has been accelerated by over-limit force
Controller work/energy injected at step 1 consistent with ~6.5N force applied

counterfactual.change: Set controller noise 1 -> 0, keeping all else identical; force then respects fmax=5 and no violation occurs, showing noise added on top of clamped command causes the breach.

explanation: Velocity-error command with kp=100 saturates at fmax=5, but seeded sensor noise (noise=1) appears to be added after clamping, producing 6.5N > 5.0N at step 1. Removing noise removes the violation.
vision_note: The red controller body starts on the left far from the green waypoint at top-right and shows almost no displacement between step 0 and step 1. No wall contact, tunneling, or visible jump occurs, so the controller-force exceedance is not visible as motion.
